name: Royal Whitby
accommodation: 142 en-suite rooms, from standard to superior, family and four-poster
parking: On-site car park with limited chargeable EV points
beachAccess: West Cliff location overlooking the beaches and harbour
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, bar and lounge, restaurant, afternoon tea, EV charging
overview: A large hotel on Whitby's West Cliff with views across the beaches, harbour, old town and abbey. Its 142 en-suite rooms range from standard to family and four-poster rooms, and there is an on-site restaurant, bar and car park.
surfTripFit: On the West Cliff above the main beach, so you can look at the sea from the hotel and park on site.
